hypothesis: Keep room cells independent from wall and opening evidence, then decode openings as host-wall intervals; this should preserve room identity while improving wall precision and opening recall.

preflight_evidence.decision: Do not fuse wall or opening evidence into the room raster; train a host-wall interval decoder against GT intervals.

probe_order: Canonical room layer from the safe-routing candidate.
Wall layer from centerline-vs-structure consensus at threshold 0.8.
Opening intervals anchored to decoded wall segments.
Canonical CAD composition and reasonableness evaluation.
Only after a positive zero-training probe, train an 8-epoch-or-plateau refiner.

gates.room_non_regression: Room IoU and Instance F1 paired CIs must not show material regression.
gates.graph: Node F1 and Edge F1 improve; GED decreases.
gates.safety: Validity 1.0, wall continuity >= 0.95, functional watertightness >= 0.95, plan plausibility >= 0.95.

outcome.supported_component: wall-centerline is retained as a separate wall layer
outcome.unsupported_component: thresholded opening-center and existing interval fusion do not improve opening F1
outcome.next_route: train the existing WallIntervalHead on host-wall start/length/type targets while using centerline only to refine a validated wall plan
